title: Total paid invoice amount per month, 2025
prompt: Finance wants total paid invoice amount per month across all accounts for 2025. Invoices start at one row each — what does a row need to represent instead?
grain: Starts at one row per invoice; ends at one row per month.
metricDefinition: sum(amount) for paid invoices, grouped by month, for 2025.
referenceSql: SELECT date_trunc('month', issued_at) AS month, sum(amount) AS total_paid FROM invoices WHERE status = 'paid' AND issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', issued_at)
